pre_existing_flakies_documented.category: F13 (NEW environmental flaky — sys.modules pollution from same-file TestModuleSysPathBranch)
pre_existing_flakies_documented.evidence: Passes 3/3 in isolation (`uv run pytest tests/unit/test_cli_with_modes.py --override-ini="addopts="`). Passes 3/3 when run alongside TestModuleSysPathBranch in either order, when invoked as `pytest tests/unit/test_cli_with_modes.py::TestModuleSysPathBranch tests/unit/test_cli_with_modes.py::TestMain`. Reproduces deterministically when `TestModuleSysPathBranch` runs immediately before `TestMain` in the full suite. Root cause: TestModuleSysPathBranch evicts and re-imports `session_buddy.cli_with_modes` with `sys.path` stripped, then restores `sys.path` but the re-imported module state remains. The subsequent string-form `monkeypatch.setattr("session_buddy.cli_with_modes.create_session_buddy_cli", ...)` resolves to a stale module reference and `main()` runs the real Typer CLI which raises 'Missing command' SystemExit. NOT a wave-1 regression — the test is correct; only its position relative to TestModuleSysPathBranch in the full suite triggers the failure. Matches the global memory entry 'Conftest sys.modules pollution pattern' (test that stubs a parent module in sys.modules at load time breaks later tests' string-form `monkeypatch.setattr`). Recommended fix: refactor TestModuleSysPathBranch to use `importlib.reload` or save/restore `sys.modules` BEFORE the strip+reimport (currently only restores AFTER), or have `conftest.py` clear `sys.modules['session_buddy.cli_with_modes']` in `pytest_runtest_setup`. Out of wave-1 scope.

open_questions_for_final_review: F13 amendment: The 4 cli_with_modes::TestMain failures are a textbook sys.modules pollution pattern from earlier tests in the same file (TestModuleSysPathBranch). Recommend either (a) amending the global 'Conftest sys.modules pollution pattern' memory to specifically mention pytest module reloads, or (b) scheduling a de-flake fix as out-of-wave-1 follow-up. Note that this is a test-isolation bug, not a source code bug — the cli_with_modes.py module itself is correct.

Test ordering recommendation: pytest collects tests in alphabetical class order by default. `TestModuleSysPathBranch` comes AFTER `TestMain` in source, so the pollution shouldn't happen during normal alphabetical collection — but in the full suite pytest uses file ordering, and the actual order in batch1b-full.log shows cli_with_modes tests collected AFTER many other test files (which mutate sys.modules earlier). The actual triggering path may be cross-file rather than intra-file; the reproduce-isolation case used `--override-ini="addopts="` and explicit collection order. Recommend tracing the exact cross-file polluter in a follow-up.
